review_notes: The file has one theorem, map_quasiIso, which is a quasi-isomorphism statement for the external tensor bifunctor on ℕ-indexed chain complexes of A- and B-modules over a field k. I read the supporting declarations: VectorComplex.totalMap_quasiIso in VectorTensorKunneth.lean, the signature of scalarForgetTotalIso_naturality, and the bifunctor definition. I found no justified generalisation. The field hypothesis is needed: the proof reduces to totalMap_quasiIso, which uses projectivity and splitting over a field. Over a general commutative ring, tensoring preserves quasi-isomorphisms only under flatness hypotheses, which would be new mathematics. The restriction to ChainComplex … ℕ comes from the upstream lemma, which relies on ChainComplex.quasiIso_iff_of_projective. Widening the complex shape would need substantial new work. A and B are already general rings, and the universe is uniform. I did not check downstream uses or other shapes in detail, so some uncertainty remains about whether a bounded-below generalisation would be cheap upstream.
